corpus.seed: reviewed Terminal Drawing Facts, invalid controls excluded

method: Label assessment. A case passes when every label named by its reviewed source facts appears in the output and no raw Mermaid syntax is shown (the diagram header, a node definition such as A[Label], or outside terminal art a piped edge label). SVG text is read from the document without a browser; terminal text directly, including labels wrapped inside boxes. Empty, error, echoed or zero-size outputs are invalid-format nonpasses; the one case whose correct drawing is empty passes only without text. Edges, arrow direction, layout and styling are not checked. PNG is not part of Drawing Correctness: OCR read only 43 of 127 labelled Mermaid PNGs rasterized from SVGs that pass 124 of 127.
